phrase.text: A generic is a subroutine or a type written once for any type: the concrete type is filled in when it is used.

runs.text: A generic is a subroutine or a type written once for any type: the concrete type is filled in when it is used.
Sometimes the same idea works for many types: a box that holds a value, a subroutine that returns what it receives. With a
after the name, a single version is written.

runs.text: What can be done with a value of type T

: the engine does not know what type it will be, so it only allows copying, passing, returning and storing the value. Adding it, comparing it or writing it is an error in the definition itself, even if every call used numbers.
